Copilot Projects just changed the agent handoff. Your brief still matters.

WHAT CHANGED
GitHub's Oct 28 release put Projects in public preview inside the Copilot app.

WHAT IT DOES
You supply a goal and context. Copilot coordinates agent work and brings results back for review. It's a place to organize the work, not permission to skip checking it.

BUILDER VALUE
A creator can turn scattered requests into one brief with named outputs and a clear review point.

Our Tech Thursday walkthrough showed why that matters: the host specified six still frames, planned five connecting clips, and worked toward a consistent Layer8 lab scene. That was a separate build, not a test of the new Projects release.

TRY THIS THIS WEEK
If you have preview access, start a Project with this brief:
"Plan a 10-second creator promo. Return six ordered frame descriptions and five transition prompts. Keep the same subject, wardrobe and destination throughout. Stop at the plan for my review."

Use your own or approved reference material. Check every transition before generating footage. This is a proposed test, not a claim that Projects will export the finished video.

THE SIGNAL
AI work is moving beyond a single answer. Learn to define the deliverables, context and review point.

Save this for your next AI-video brief.
